sample_essay:
A growing body of research finds that violent video games can make kids act aggressively in their real world relationships, causing an increase in violence. This phenomenon has sparked a heated debate on whether violent video games lead to violence.

To begin with, exposure to violent video games can desensitize players to real-world violence. For example, when constantly seeing virtual bloodshed and aggression, players may become less empathetic towards others' pain. In addition, these games often reward violent behavior. Players are encouraged to use force to achieve goals, which can create a wrong perception that violence is an acceptable way to solve problems. 

However, it's important to note that not all players of violent video games become violent. Some people can distinguish between virtual and real life well. Family environment, education, and personal character also play significant roles in a person's tendency towards violence. 

In conclusion, while violent video games may contribute to an increase in aggression, they are not the sole cause of real-world violence. We should view this issue comprehensively and take appropriate measures to guide players, especially young ones, to have a correct attitude towards these games.
